---
name: Device benchmark
about: Submit reproducible, privacy-safe local inference measurements
---

## Device and software

Device model, RAM tier, OS, app commit, runtime revision/backend, model source/revision/hash/quantization, context/output limits. Omit serial numbers and personal paths.

## Workload

Synthetic fixture version, run counts, cold/warm conditions, thermal/power state, and test commands.

## Measurements

End-to-end turn latency and percentiles, first final-response latency, load/prefill/decode time, peak memory, sustained-session behavior, failures, cancellation, and available energy/thermal measurements.

## Quality and limitations

Schema-valid plans, accepted outcomes, critical contradictions, secrecy tests, and unmeasured fields. Never estimate a missing measurement as if observed.
